title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Article on the Resident's Notice of Termination
content:
## Article 9 — Termination by the resident

9.1 A residency under the Independent Living Residency Agreement is terminated by the resident only through a written notice of termination signed on the resident's behalf; the desk registers the notice request with the intended vacate date the resident states, and the resident signs it.

9.2 The notice must be signed by the resident, or by a representative whose representative authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or a guardianship; a healthcare power of attorney or an authorized contact alone cannot give notice. The same signing authority applies to a withdrawal of notice.

9.3 *Retired clause.* The clause under which the notice period was the move-out notice period for a resident leaving Larkspur and the shortened internal transfer notice period when the notice states a move to a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for notice periods. The remainder of the sentence stays in force: the intended vacate date may be earlier than the end of the notice period, but fees still run as set by the fee end rules.

9.4 A notice may be withdrawn only before the intended vacate date stated on it. The withdrawal window is counted in calendar days and closes at the end of the day before the intended vacate date, so a withdrawal signed on the intended vacate date itself is refused. The cutoff is 0 days before the intended vacate date: no day of grace remains once that date arrives.

9.5 After a withdrawal the residency continues unchanged as if no notice had been given, and a later departure needs a new notice with a new notice period.

## Who may sign (from the representative authority on the customer profile)

| Signer | May sign a notice or a withdrawal? |
|---|---|
| The resident | Yes |
| Financial power of attorney | Yes |
| Durable power of attorney | Yes |
| Guardian | Yes |
| Healthcare power of attorney alone | No |
| Authorized contact alone | No |

## Withdrawal at its boundary (hypothetical; intended vacate date the 20th)

| Withdrawal signed on | Outcome |
|---|---|
| The 18th | Accepted |
| The 19th (the day before the intended vacate date) | Accepted — the window closes at the end of this day |
| The 20th (the intended vacate date) | Refused |

superseded_clauses: The notice period is move_out_notice_days for a resident leaving Larkspur and internal_transfer_notice_days when the notice states a move to a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence
